artifacts.summary: Confirms the Class A nonexistent-dependency false positive (root cause: active_projects-only lookup), empirically reproduces it in this repo (20/20 flagged edges are archived, 0 genuinely nonexistent), and recommends reusing scripts/lib/task-lookup-lib.sh (already proven by orchestrate-triage-classify.sh) to add a distinct archived-satisfied bucket; finds batch-admit.sh and triage-classify.sh need no correction.

memory_candidates.content: scripts/lib/task-lookup-lib.sh is the codebase's single source of truth for archive-aware task lookup (task_lookup_archived_projects_json/task_lookup_entry/task_lookup_is_active/task_lookup_dir), reading specs/archive/state.json's completed_projects+archived_projects and normalizing status. Any /orchestrate-family script that resolves a task or dependency number against specs/state.json's active_projects[] ONLY will silently misclassify an archived (terminal, satisfied) task as absent/nonexistent once /todo moves it out of active_projects[]. When passing the archived array into jq, use --slurpfile from a mktemp file rather than --argjson: a real archive/state.json can exceed OS argv/ARG_MAX (observed ~960KB triggering 'Argument list too long', exit 126).
